subject.title: Test methodology: enforce failing-first on fix-bearing PRs

question: Should OpenClaw adopt failing-first as non-blocking PR-template/reviewer guidance now, or invest in a CI-enforced check for selected fix-bearing PRs?
rationale: The evidence supports improving regression-test scrutiny, but choosing enforcement level determines contributor burden, CI cost, false-positive tolerance, and the required implementation surface.

options.title: Start with review guidance
options.body: Add a concise non-blocking failing-first prompt plus one worked example to the contributor/reviewer process, then assess whether it improves review quality.

options.title: Prototype CI enforcement
options.body: Define a narrow, opt-in or label-scoped base-versus-head test experiment only after documenting supported test classes and expected exceptions.

options.title: Keep current process
options.body: Retain existing behavior-focused review guidance without adding a dedicated failing-first expectation.

recommendation.title: Start with review guidance
recommendation.body: Add a concise non-blocking failing-first prompt plus one worked example to the contributor/reviewer process, then assess whether it improves review quality.
